summary: Internal DMPK working deck (v2, 17 March 2014) comparing how microsomal CLint and hepatocyte depletion CLint are normalised and reported, with species assumptions and open points for the exposure gate. Speaker notes are Matteo's informal working comments.

slides.title: Clearance normalisation: microsomal vs hepatocyte CLint
slides.subtitle: Internal DMPK working deck | v2 | 03/17/2014
slides.notes: v2 of the Friday version. Still need to fix the mg/ml vs mg/mL labels before this goes to Megan.

slides.title: Why this deck
bullets: Microsomal and hepatocyte CLint are being reported side by side on the same test article sets, and the units do not line up
Need one agreed normalisation before the exposure gate memo goes out

bullets.text: Current memo draft uses µL/min/mg for both assays; that is not right for the hepatocyte data

bullets: Species assumptions still differ between the two worksheets
slides.notes: Megan asked for a one-pager on this. This is the long version, cut it down later.

slides.title: How each assay is normalised

rows: Liver microsomes; preparation recorded on the assay worksheet
Hepatocytes; lot and donor information recorded on the assay worksheet
As specified in the study protocol
As specified in the study protocol

slides.notes: The mg/ml vs mg/mL spelling is inconsistent across the worksheets. Pick one and stick to it.

slides.title: Unit conversion: the trap
bullets: Protein-normalised and cell-normalised values are not interchangeable

bullets.text: A direct comparison needs the scaling step written out in the methods, not assumed

bullets: Some legacy worksheets carry µM and nM labels on the same column

bullets.text: Check the concentration unit on each worksheet before merging

bullets: Clearance is reported only where the depletion curve is log-linear over the sampling window

slides.title: Species assumptions
slides.subtitle: What we are assuming and what we have not checked

slides.title: Species: what we have and what we assume
bullets: Confirm the species requested against each study protocol
Record microsomal preparation and protein concentration on the assay worksheet
Check hepatocyte donor composition and viable cell density in the source lot record
bullets_right: Do not assume rat clearance predicts human rank order
Microsomal and hepatocyte depletion can differ within the same species
[TBC] check the human hepatocyte lot record before the Q2 work is scoped
slides.notes: Carole has the donor sheets. Ask her before we say anything about mouse.

slides.title: Matrix acceptance for the two assays
bullets: Microsomal acceptance checks include reference metabolism and the appropriate cofactor controls
Hepatocyte acceptance checks include viability and reference metabolism under the study conditions
Apply the assay-specific acceptance criteria recorded in the SOP

bullets.text: Investigate failed acceptance before reporting clearance; document any repeat

slides.notes: Helen wants the acceptance wording copied exactly from the SOP, not paraphrased.

slides.title: Analyte cards and quantitation
bullets: Each analyte card records the calibration range used for the depletion measurement
Tandem-MS quantitation on the parent-to-product transition, internal standard on every sample
Fit depletion only to quantifiable points in an appropriate log-linear interval; report slow depletion as a limit where a half-life cannot be estimated reliably

slides.title: What goes into the exposure gate
bullets: Microsomal CLint, species-matched to the PK study
Hepatocyte CLint where phase II contribution is suspected
bullets_right: Units stated in every table header
Assumptions footnoted, not buried in the methods

slides.title: Open points
bullets: Agree one unit convention for protein and cell basis across both worksheets
Confirm mouse hepatocyte value is needed for any current study
Decide which assay informs the exposure memo, with its own normalisation basis stated
Clean up the legacy worksheet labels before archiving
slides.notes: Don't send this version outside the department. The v3 will have the agreed units.

slides.title: Next steps
bullets: Megan to review the normalisation table this week
Javier to confirm the mass-spec transitions used for the hepatocyte samples
Anna to pull the donor sheets for the human hepatocyte lot
Revise deck to v3 once units are agreed

slides.title: Back-up: reference compounds
bullets: Reference compounds selected for the species and assay conditions in the study protocol
Reference performance checked against the assay-specific acceptance criteria
Reagent and cell lot references recorded on the assay worksheet
